values.prompt:
Create a clean, neutral production character sheet for Ada.

## Views
Five vertical sections: FACE CLOSE UP, FRONT, BACK, LEFT PROFILE, RIGHT PROFILE. Keep the same person in the same simple travel dress and boots. Arms relaxed, feet visible, poses neutral.

## Face and identity
The close-up is straight-on and centered, cropped from the top of the head through the neck and ending above the shoulders. No angled portrait or torso detail. Preserve auburn bob-length hair, pale freckled skin, narrow face, watchful expression, and slight forward tension in posture.

## Scale and synopsis
Height is binding: 5 ft 6 in / 168 cm. Include a labeled height ruler with numeric tick marks beside the full-body views and align proportions to it. Below the close-up show: Name: Ada; Height: 5 ft 6 in / 168 cm; Synopsis: watchful courier in a simple travel dress. Do not invent age, weight, or gender.

## Accessory and exclusions
Show one small brass hair clip in a separate accessory cell. No location shots, story scenes, expression range, extra props, weapons, other characters, or long generated notes.
